description: Render the whole card — identity, AGENTS.md, memory, discovery — as one self-contained HTML page a person can read or screenshot. AGENTS.md sections collapse by default; pass expanded:true for the full render. Also served at GET /card (?expand=all) over the HTTP transport.

accent.description: CSS hex colour, e.g. #FF702D (default: the AAIF palette)

expanded.description: render every AGENTS.md section open (default: collapsed)

name: render_context_card
title: Render Context Card
